source: National Rail Enquiries, via the Rail Data Marketplace
messages: Severe weather associated with Storm Austen and Storm Boelo may disrupt your journey. Check before you travel. More details and the impact on your journey can be found in the Disruptions area of the National Rail website .

Trains between Sheffield and Manchester Piccadilly / Chesterfield may be delayed by up to 30 minutes, cancelled or revised. Latest information can be found in the Disruptions area of the National Rail website .
The ticket office is currently closed at this station.

departures.reason: This service has been delayed by a speed restriction because of high winds
